entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The parties to the lis, the husband and the wife and other members of the family have settled the dispute and have preferred a joint affidavit.

The joint affidavit reads as under :
We, (1) Mr. Srinivasa K, S/o. Krishnappa, Aged 32 years and (2) Mrs. Nandini B.M,
W/o Srinivasa K, Aged about 28 years, both are residing at No.62, No.62, Bidalapura Village, Channarayapatna Hobli, Devanahalli Taluk, Bengaluru Rural Dist-562129,
do hereby solemnly affirm & state on oath as follows- 1.

We are the Petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 respectively in the above petition,
we are husband and wife and petitioner No.2 and 3 are our parents and in- laws respectively.
We are well conversant with the facts of the case.

Hence, we are swearing to this affidavit,
2.

We submit that first deponent have filed the above petition for quashing the further proceedings in C.C. No.1555 of 2024, pending before Additional Civil Judge & JMFC Devanahalli, Bangalore rural dist for the alleged offences punishable under Section 498A, 504, 506, 34 of the Indian Penal Code 1860 against me and my parents.

entities.text: Additional Civil Judge & JMFC Devanahalli, Bangalore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3. We state that we have amicably settled the marital dispute between us and we are livening together along with our two children and second deponent doest continue the criminal proceedings and wishes to NC: 2024:KHC:45588 withdraw the same against first deponent and his parents,
hence the same needs to be quashed.

Wherefore, we humbly pray that this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to consider the joint affidavit filed by us and be pleased to quash the criminal proceedings in C.C. No.1555 of 2024,
pending before Additional Civil Judge & JMFC, Devanahalli, Bangalore Rural Dist for the alleged offences punishable under Section 498A, 504, 506, 34 of the Indian Penal Code 1860 against first deponent, in the interest of justice.

3. In the light of the offences being the one punishable under Sections 498A, 504, 506 and not against the State, I deem it appropriate to accept the application compounding and pass the following:
ORDER i) The Criminal petition is disposed, and ii) The proceedings in C.C.No.1555/2024 pending on the file of the Additional Civil Judge and J.M.F.C, Devanahalli, Bangalore Rural District, qua the petitioners, stand quashed.
